truths.truth: AC1 / HEAR-03: his own stop phrase heard back, during the line and in the ring after, goes through Wake.stop_in and Wake.check, never stops him, and starts no turn, on both the native Speaker and the page's player
truths.evidence: Ran tests/test_scenes.py::FastScenes::test_his_own_stop_phrase_heard_back_never_stops_him_on_the_native_path and ..._on_the_page_path: both PASSED. The scene (tests/test_scenes.py:342-372) asserts an 'echo (peek)' drop of a stop phrase under ECHO_MIN words, a closing stop phrase ending within ECHO_TAIL judged by Wake.check ('echo (over|follow)'), did(t)==[], and that his sound plays to the line's last chunk. It then reruns with gate.own_stop patched to False and asserts a barge, so the rule is what holds him. Wiring: app/server.py:1901, :1918, :1987 pass played_lately() and h.words into gate.judge. The drop is at app/gate.py:188 (own_stop gated on kind != 'listen' and words not None). tests/test_echo.py::Callers (3 tests) PASSED. Caveat (plan-3 report, open item 5): on the page path the closing 9 s burst in Wake.check is dropped by is_echo's text, so there the rule decides only at the stop peeks. The slow real-Whisper twins (:617, :620) were skipped, not run here.
